items.name: Lesotho Nationals 2026

venue.name: [Lancer's Inn Hotel Maseru](https://www.lancersinn.co.ls/)
venue.address: Road & Kingsway Central Private Bag A 216, Pioneer corner, Maseru 100, Lesotho

items.information:
First official WCA competition in Lesotho.

The fastest competitor from Lesotho in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Lesotho.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Lesotho nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Lesotho nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.
